{
 "description": "Denotes the Identifier of the revocation.\n\n| Identifier| Description|\n|-----------|------------|\n| LFI | Revoked by LFI without User initiation|\n| TPP | Revoked by TPP without User initiation|\n| LFI.InitiatedByUser | Initiated by User via the LFI|\n| TPP.InitiatedByUser | Initiated by User via the TPP|\n",
 "type": "string",
 "enum": [
 "LFI",
 "TPP",
 "LFI.InitiatedByUser",
 "TPP.InitiatedByUser"
 ]
}
